lsof -ti tcp:3107 | xargs kill 2>/dev/null; git status --short && git add -A "apps/web/app" && git commit -q -m "fix(web): make the flip card's hidden face inert, name reference links by topic

Lighthouse flagged two things on the landing page. The state card's back
face was aria-hidden while its highlighted <pre> (tabindex=0) stayed in the
tab order; inert takes it out of both the tab order and hit-testing, so the
pointer-events class goes too. And every instrument's reference bar ended in
links named just \"docs\" and \"source\" pointing at different URLs; they now
carry the chapter topic in their accessible name, visible label first.
